text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono claims a spectacular victory 
in the Mile CS!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While Taiki Shuttle felt satisfied, 
admitting it was frustrating but fun, the 
stands couldn't hide their excitement over 
what was a truly gripping, spectacular 
race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Looking at such a scene, Hishi Akebono's 
own heart was filled with warmth and 
completely stuffed full!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Amidst unending cheers, the Mile 
Championship came to a close.
